title: Symbiodinium-enriched RNA extraction from Aiptasia holobiont
author: Anthony Bellantuono
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rbjd2kn

steps.title: Freeze and Store Anemones
steps.instruction: Freeze anemones in minimal seawater in 2 ml cryotubes using liquid nitrogen and store at -80°C until extraction.

steps.title: Initial Host Lysis and Tissue Dislodgement
steps.instruction: Add 500 ul of host lysis buffer (containing 2-mercaptoethanol) to the tube with the frozen anemone and flick until the frozen tissue is dislodged, then decant the contents into a 1.5 ml centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Homogenize and Pellet Tissue
steps.instruction: Homogenize the tissue and centrifuge to isolate the symbiont pellet.

substeps.instruction: Gently homogenize tissue with a plastic pestle
Vortex at maximum speed for 1 minute
Centrifuge homogenate at 10,000 g for 3 min
Remove and discard supernatant, leaving the symbiont pellet intact

steps.title: First Symbiont Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet using host lysis buffer.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in 1.4 ml of host lysis buffer and vortex until homogenized
Centrifuge suspension at 3,000 g for 3 min

steps.title: Second Symbiont Wash
steps.instruction: Perform a second wash of the pellet using host lysis buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.4 ml of host lysis buffer
Vortex at maximum speed until homogenous

steps.title: Symbiodinium Lysis via Bead Beating
steps.instruction: Resuspend the Symbiodinium pellet in 600 ul Buffer RLT (Qiagen) and perform mechanical lysis.

substeps.instruction: Transfer resuspension to a screw top 2.0 ml tube
Bead beat for 1 min at 6 m/s using approximately 100 μl glass beads

steps.title: Extract and Purify RNA
steps.instruction: Clear the lysate and process the RNA using the Qiagen RNeasy Mini Kit.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate for 3 min at 14,000 g
Carefully remove the cleared lysate supernatant by pipetting and transfer to a new microcentrifuge tube
Add 1 volume of 70% ethanol to the sample
Process with Qiagen RNeasy Mini Kit per manufacturer instructions, including on-column DNAse treatment
Optional: Perform an additional RPE Buffer wash and/or 80% ethanol wash prior to elution to eliminate salt contamination
